channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: WATCH: Man Runs 7 Marathons in 7 Days Aboard Cruise Ship
item.description: ABC News' Danny New interviews an ultra trail runner from Scotland who spent his Mediterranean cruise by running seven marathons in seven days.

item.title: 70 marathon runners evacuated after heavy rain stranding
item.description: About 70 runners and volunteers in Utah's Moab 240 ultramarathon were stranded overnight after a significant storm.

item.title: New manhole mystery emerges on Manhattan's Upper West Side
item.description: Three men were seen climbing into a sewer system in the latest in a series of incidents across New York City.

item.title: Pope Leo to undergo surgery after lung lesion found, Vatican says
item.description: The American pope has no previously known health problems and is known to be physically active.
